eventDetail.scope: AIMLSystems is a conference, now at its sixth edition, targeting research in the intersection of Systems Engineering and Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques. Through this conference, we plan to examine how immense strides in AI/ML techniques are enabled by advances in computational systems, and how the use of AI/ML can support data-driven exploration of the design space of computational systems. We also investigate how new breeds of AI/ML systems enable new forms of socio-techno-economic systems, which, in turn, generate new research requirements in AI/ML techniques. The conference welcomes submissions of original research papers that address the following topics: Scalable and Efficient AI-ML Techniques; System Architectures for AI-ML Applications; Design of Socio-Economic Systems based on AI-ML; Domain-Specific AI-ML solutions; Safe/Responsible AI Systems. Moreover, an Industrial Track addresses Industrial AI-ML Systems Design, Real-World Challenges.
